watch.summary: The streamer reacts to a Valorant esports broadcast, praising the stage design that places coaches directly behind players.

beats.what: The creator notices coaches sitting behind players on the stage.
He explains how coaches used to be kept hidden off-stage.
He compares the visibility of coaches to traditional sports like soccer.
He jokes about past esports setups looking like coaches trapped in dark rooms with headlamps.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: This clip is an insightful commentary on esports broadcast production rather than a comedy beat. Although the streamer laughs at a hyperbolic mental image of past setups, the clip is primarily informational.
